current_role: Far-right streamer and host of America First; leader of the Groyper movement
summary: Nick Fuentes is a far-right commentator who hosts the America First show and leads the online Groyper movement; the ADL and SPLC describe him as a white supremacist, and he is widely described as antisemitic and a Holocaust denier. He founded the America First Political Action Conference in 2020, spoke near the Capitol on January 6, 2021, and dined with Donald Trump and Ye at Mar-a-Lago in November 2022. After an October 2025 Tucker Carlson interview widened his reach, he has feuded with JD Vance and turned against Trump.

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Fuentes backed Trump through the 2020 "Stop the Steal" campaign and dined with him and Ye at Mar-a-Lago in November 2022 (Trump said he did not know who Fuentes was). He later turned on Trump: in 2026 he attacked Trump as a liar, said he would not vote in the midterms and would back a Democrat over Vance or Rubio. Trump has largely not responded, and in November 2025 he defended Tucker Carlson's interview with Fuentes.

connections.name: Tucker Carlson
connections.description: Carlson gave Fuentes a friendly interview on October 28, 2025, but by December 2025 Fuentes had turned on him, calling him a liar and a "faker" and telling him to stay away. In late 2026 Fuentes kept attacking him, calling Carlson a "true Jew hater" and accusing him of fearmongering about Iran to boost JD Vance for 2028.
